subject: Consumption thresholds and burst pricing review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma@kiteretail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: consumption profile & burst behavior (recap + ask)

Hi Emma — thanks again for the demo call earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can match on pricing/quota paths before I draft an initial SOW:

Recap (what I heard)
- Baseline inference: 100–140M tokens / month (mostly embedding + short chat prompts).
- Daily peak pattern: short spikes (2–6 hours) during PST morning push and an evening promo window; spikes can reach ~2–3x baseline for those windows.
- Need for predictable unit economics: finance wants a target around $700 / 1M tokens (ballpark you gave on call).

Open asks for us to size proposals properly
1) Can you confirm an average monthly token range (low / expected / high) for Q3? a quick number is fine.
2) How long are typical spikes? (you mentioned 2–6 hours; are there any multi-day events?)
3) Tolerance for throttling during spikes — is graceful degradation acceptable for non-essential routes?
4) Any procurement constraints for overage billing (e.g., do you require a single consolidated monthly invoice vs line-itemed overages)?

What I'll propose next (once you confirm)
- Baseline quota + temporary burst window definition (automatic soft bursts, and a defined overage tier if traffic goes beyond the soft window).
- Two overage pricing bands for clarity (small overages billed at a moderated uplift; larger sustained overages at a higher uplift).
- A conservative canary for the first month if you want to avoid surprise spend.

Attaching a short burst policy draft and a usage-template to fill in (see attachments). If you can reply with the three quick numbers above today, I can push a draft SOW + pricing sheet by EOD.

Thanks — M.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood-burst-policy-v1.pdf (policy stub), usage-projections-kiteretail.xlsx (spreadsheet template)

From: Emma Johnson <emma@kiteretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kite Retail - Billing <billing@kiteretail.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: consumption profile & burst behavior (recap + ask)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming numbers below so you can size the SOW:

- Avg month (low / expected / high): 80M / 120M / 220M tokens.
- Spike duration: typically 2–4 hours for daily promos; once a quarter we run a weekend sale that can create a 24–36 hour sustained uplift to ~3x.
- Throttling tolerance: non-critical personalization routes should be ok to degrade; checkout-flows need low latency and minimal throttling.
- Billing preference: consolidated monthly invoice is preferred. We prefer predictable unit economics — finance would like to hold at roughly $650–$750 / 1M tokens if possible.

Also: procurement asked whether you can provide a temporary quota increase workflow (auto-approve up to X% for soft bursts, manual approval above that) and a clear overage uplift schedule.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

— Emma
Director of Engineering, Kite Retail
emma@kiteretail.com

On Tue, May 2, 2027 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Emma — thanks again for the demo call earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can match on pricing/quota paths before I draft an initial SOW:...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma@kiteretail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Kite Retail - Billing <billing@kiteretail.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: consumption profile & burst behavior (recap + ask) — proposed pricing bands

Emma — perfect, thanks for the detail. Based on the numbers you provided, here is a draft approach for internal review and for you to comment on:

Proposal (draft)
- Baseline quota: 150M tokens / month (covers expected + a buffer).
- Soft burst allowance: up to 20% above baseline (auto-allowed, no uplift) to cover short anomalies.
- Burst window policy: allow bursts up to 3x baseline for short windows (<= 6 hours) as "temporary burst" if within monthly spike budget; these will be recorded and flagged but not immediately invoiced above soft allowance.
- Overage pricing tiers (monthly):
  * Tier A (0–20% over baseline): billed at baseline unit price (no uplift) — treated as part of soft-burst allowance.
  * Tier B (20–50% over baseline): billed at 1.25x unit price.
  * Tier C (>50% over baseline): billed at 1.5x unit price; requires post-facto review and manual approval for continued allowance.

Unit economics example (using your target)
- If we set baseline unit price = $700 / 1M tokens, Tier B = $875 / 1M, Tier C = $1,050 / 1M.

Operational notes
- Temporary quota increases: we can support an auto-approve window for "soft bursts" up to 20%. Anything beyond that triggers an automated notification to your procurement POC and our sales ops for 2-hour SLA to respond (we can tighten that for enterprise).
- Canary month: recommend we run a canary for month 1 with conservative caps on non-critical routes (we'll route checkout through a reserved capacity pool to guarantee SLAs while letting personalization run through burst policy).

Next steps
1) Marissa to send a formal SOW + pricing sheet (I will include the three pricing bands and an example invoice layout).
2) Emma to confirm whether Kite wants Tier B to be automatically applied or require manual confirmation each month.
3) Agree on a start date for the canary and who owns the monitoring signals.

I've attached the redwood-burst-policy-v1.pdf again and a SOW stub. Priyom — can you take the lead on the pricing sheet draft? Rishi — pending your sign-off, I can share this proposal with Kite's procurement.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: consumption profile & burst behavior (recap + ask) — provisional approval

Marissa / Priyom — quick note: I approve moving forward with the draft bands and the 150M baseline provisional quota. Two asks before we share final with Kite: 

1) Make Tier B automatic for the first 90 days but cap total overage billing exposure at 30% for that period (finance safety).
2) Add a short monitoring playbook in the SOW: what signals we will emit (token rate, 95p latency, error rate) and who the escalation contacts are.

Marissa — once Priyom has the pricing sheet, loop me in and I'll sign-off so you can send to procurement. Keep the canary as proposed.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
